scenario: AITA for calling this woman ugly in front of everyone? | Yesterday I was at ShopRite standing at the checkout lane and there was a huge line. I was staring off into space sideways and unfortunately, there was a woman in my line of vision and I didn't notice her. This woman loudly asked me again and made a scene about how I was ogling at her body and that I was a creep. I was stunned but angry and I finally managed to tell her 'you are too ugly to be stared at. I was looking at the person behind you fatso'. She became livid and walked off. Was I justified in being rude?
